fixed.summary: The HUD's meters, bars, buttons, prompts and feed rows draw their grounds on pack slots and theme roles in those grounds' inks, so their text reads over a bright scene in every pack (the action button's fill, the bar and orb-meter sheens, the killfeed and loot-entry rows and the QTE keycaps).

Compass, interaction prompt, minimap, minimap view and speech bubble draw their grounds on theme roles in those grounds' inks, so their text reads over a bright scene in every pack (the compass and minimap ticks, the minimap view's heading cone and the speech bubble's progress line).

The inspector's tool buttons, tree rows, section headers and field editors use the surface-hover ground for hover and selection and the accent ground in its own ink for the on state, so their text reads in every pack.
